answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the ivory of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the juniper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
